purpose: Turn the 16 evidence-bound comparison systems into a genuinely comparable dataset — not merely 16 pages displaying similar categories.

identical_metric_definitions.rule: Same metric IDs and panel definitions across all 16 bound systems for each shared domain.

identical_geography_rules.rule: State US / Arkansas / Arkansas_county / multi_state explicitly. National dials never become Arkansas outcomes by implication.

compatible_time_periods.rule: Prefer panel-published periods. Label each period explicitly; never blend into a fake contemporaneous snapshot. Compatible ≠ identical when sources differ — mark incompatibility.

explicit_missing_data_treatment.rule: Missing cells stay missing. Do not impute, proxy-swap, or hide gaps to look complete.

source_provenance.rule: Every critical number retains metric_id / source_id / panel_id provenance already registered.

comparable_vs_non_comparable_markers.rule: When definitions, periods, or geographies are not aligned, mark the dial non-comparable for cross-system use.

holds: HYP-125 through HYP-130 stay research tracks

harmonization_pass.scope: Audit the 16 bound dossiers + phase2_evidence objects against definition_control; fix language and markers only — no new systems.
